traceability.evidence:
Story file: - docs/stories/006.0-DEV-FILE-VALIDATION.story.md exists and defines requirements REQ-FILE-EXISTENCE, REQ-ERROR-HANDLING, REQ-ANNOTATION-VALIDATION, REQ-PATH-RESOLUTION, REQ-SECURITY-VALIDATION, REQ-PERFORMANCE-OPTIMIZATION, REQ-PROJECT-BOUNDARY, REQ-CONFIGURABLE-PATHS.
Core implementation: - src/rules/valid-story-reference.ts - ESLint rule module annotated with @story docs/stories/006.0-DEV-FILE-VALIDATION.story.md and requirement tags. - Uses context.cwd ?? process.cwd for path resolution (per Implementation Notes). - Parses comments to find @story lines (handleComment, validateStoryPath), satisfying REQ-ANNOTATION-VALIDATION. - processStoryPath() enforces security (performSecurityValidations), extension (hasValidExtension + requireStoryExtension option), then delegates existence and boundary checks (reportExistenceProblems). - reportExistenceProblems() + reportExistenceStatus() use normalizeStoryPath() to distinguish exists / missing / fs-error and report messageIds fileMissing, invalidPath, fileAccessError. - Rule meta defines messages: - fileMissing: "Story file '{{path}}' not found". - invalidExtension: "Invalid story file extension for '{{path}}', expected '.story.md'". - invalidPath: "Invalid story path '{{path}}'". - fileAccessError: detailed filesystem error message including {{path}} and {{error}}. - Options schema supports storyDirectories, allowAbsolutePaths, requireStoryExtension (REQ-CONFIGURABLE-PATHS).
Supporting helpers: - src/rules/helpers/valid-story-reference-helpers.ts - performSecurityValidations(): checks absolute paths and traversal; reports invalidPath when disallowed (REQ-SECURITY-VALIDATION, REQ-PROJECT-BOUNDARY). - handleProjectBoundaryForExistence(): uses enforceProjectBoundary to ensure matched paths and candidates stay within project root; if all candidates are outside, reports invalidPath (REQ-PROJECT-BOUNDARY, REQ-CONFIGURABLE-PATHS). - src/utils/storyReferenceUtils.ts - buildStoryCandidates(): builds candidate absolute paths from storyPath, cwd, and storyDirectories, covering direct cwd resolution and configured directories (REQ-PATH-RESOLUTION). - fileExistStatusCache and checkSingleCandidate(): cache fs.existsSync/statSync results, never throw, return status 'exists' | 'missing' | 'fs-error' (REQ-FILE-EXISTENCE, REQ-PERFORMANCE-OPTIMIZATION, REQ-ERROR-HANDLING). - getStoryExistence(): aggregates across candidates, preferring an existing file, then fs-error, else missing (REQ-FILE-EXISTENCE, REQ-ERROR-HANDLING). - storyExists(): boolean wrapper preserving backward compatibility (used and tested in error-handling tests). - normalizeStoryPath(): builds candidates, computes StoryExistenceResult and boolean exists (REQ-PATH-RESOLUTION, REQ-FILE-EXISTENCE, REQ-ERROR-HANDLING, REQ-PERFORMANCE-OPTIMIZATION). - enforceProjectBoundary(): ensures normalized candidate is within the project root (REQ-PROJECT-BOUNDARY).
Tests (all passing): - Global run: `npm test -- --verbose` – 38 suites, 290 tests passed, including: - tests/rules/valid-story-reference.test.ts – multiple describes explicitly referencing "Story 006.0-DEV-FILE-VALIDATION". - Targeted run: `npm test -- --verbose --runTestsByPath tests/rules/valid-story-reference.test.ts` – 1 suite, 21 tests all passed.
Key tests per requirement in tests/rules/valid-story-reference.test.ts: - Header: - `* Tests for: docs/stories/006.0-DEV-FILE-VALIDATION.story.md` - `@story docs/stories/006.0-DEV-FILE-VALIDATION.story.md` and @req entries for REQ-FILE-EXISTENCE and REQ-ERROR-HANDLING.
- REQ-FILE-EXISTENCE: - Valid: "[REQ-FILE-EXISTENCE] valid story file reference" using `// @story docs/stories/001.0-DEV-PLUGIN-SETUP.story.md` (and that file exists in docs/stories). No errors expected. - Invalid: "[REQ-PATH-RESOLUTION] missing file" with `// @story docs/stories/missing-file.story.md` expects messageId 'fileMissing'.
- REQ-EXTENSION & core .story.md behavior (part of Core Functionality acceptance criterion): - Valid: "[REQ-EXTENSION] valid .story.md extension". - Invalid: "[REQ-EXTENSION] invalid extension" with `.md` expects messageId 'invalidExtension'.
- REQ-PATH-RESOLUTION: - "[REQ-PATH-RESOLUTION] valid relative path with ./ prefix". - Missing-file case above uses ordinary relative path. - Jest test: "[REQ-CONFIGURABLE-PATHS] uses storyDirectories when resolving relative paths (Story 006.0-DEV-FILE-VALIDATION)" uses mockFsForExistingFile and runRuleOnCode to confirm behavior with storyDirectories.
- REQ-SECURITY-VALIDATION: - "[REQ-PATH-SECURITY] path traversal" with `// @story ../outside.story.md` => messageId 'invalidPath'. - "[REQ-ABSOLUTE-PATH] absolute path not allowed" with `/etc/passwd.story.md` => messageId 'invalidPath'.
- REQ-CONFIGURABLE-PATHS: - configurablePathsTester: "[REQ-CONFIGURABLE-PATHS] honors custom storyDirectories using docs/stories". - allowAbsolutePathsTester: * Valid when allowAbsolutePaths: true and storyDirectories: ["docs/stories"]. * Invalid with messageId 'invalidPath' when allowAbsolutePaths: false. - relaxedExtensionTester: "[REQ-CONFIGURABLE-PATHS] accepts .story.md story path when requireStoryExtension is false (still valid and existing)". - Additional Jest tests under "Valid Story Reference Rule Configuration and Boundaries" for storyDirectories resolution and requireStoryExtension=false allowing .md files when they exist.
- REQ-PROJECT-BOUNDARY: - "[REQ-PROJECT-BOUNDARY] story reference outside project root is rejected when discovered via absolute path" – uses an absolute path under a fake outside-project root and expects invalidPath. - Jest tests: * "[REQ-PROJECT-BOUNDARY] storyDirectories cannot escape project even when normalize resolves outside cwd". * "[REQ-PROJECT-BOUNDARY] misconfigured storyDirectories outside project cannot validate external files" – uses mockFsForExistingFile for an external path, runRuleOnCode, and asserts diagnostics include messageId 'invalidPath'.
- REQ-ERROR-HANDLING: - Jest tests under "Valid Story Reference Rule Error Handling (Story 006.0-DEV-FILE-VALIDATION)": * storyExists returns false when fs throws (simulated EACCES) and does not throw. * storyExists returns false when fs.statSync throws EIO and existsSync is true. * Rule reports fileAccessError when fs.statSync throws and existsSync is true; diagnostics filtered by messageId 'fileAccessError' and error message matched against /EIO/. * Rule reports fileAccessError when fs throws (EACCES), also checking diagnostics and error text.
Documentation: - docs/rules/valid-story-reference.md - Tagged with @story docs/stories/006.0-DEV-FILE-VALIDATION.story.md and reqs REQ-FILE-EXISTENCE, REQ-PATH-RESOLUTION, REQ-SECURITY-VALIDATION. - Describes behavior, boundary rules, differentiation between fileMissing, invalidExtension, invalidPath, and fileAccessError. - Documents configuration options and provides correct/incorrect examples matching the story’s examples (correct .story.md path; invalid: nonexistent, wrong extension, traversal, absolute path).
All relevant tests pass in the full suite and in an isolated run of tests/rules/valid-story-reference.test.ts, and the implementation and documentation directly address every requirement and acceptance criterion in the story.
